# fixture-notes

A tiny notes app with a login. Synthetic: the one demo user is alice, and all data lives in memory.

Run it with `npm start`. It listens on the port in the PORT variable (3000 by default).

Routes: `GET /`, `GET /login`, `POST /api/login`, `GET /api/me`, `POST /api/logout`, `GET /api/notes`, `POST /api/notes`.
